title: Motor Stall
shortDescription: Valve motor failed to reach next cycle position.
fullDescription: Err 1 on GE softeners (GXSH, GXSF series) indicates the valve motor stalled during a regen step, often due to debris in the valve or a worn motor.

title: Position Switch Fault
fullDescription: Err 2 posts when the cam switch does not close at the expected point in rotation, usually indicating a failed switch or bent cam finger.

fixSteps.title: Inspect switch
fixSteps.instruction: Use multimeter to verify switch continuity as cam rotates.

fixSteps.title: Replace part
fixSteps.instruction: Swap switch or cam assembly as needed.

faq.a: Yes, turn bypass valve to supply hard water.

title: Regen Timeout
fullDescription: Err 3 occurs when brine draw, backwash, or fast rinse took longer than the expected duration.
whenToCallPro: If drain line is blocked underground.

faq.a: Closed inlet valve or plumbing filter clog.

title: Flow Meter Error
fullDescription: Err 4 indicates the flow meter is not registering water use. Demand regen cannot schedule.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Push turbine cable into control board.

fixSteps.title: Clean turbine
fixSteps.instruction: Remove turbine and soak in vinegar.

faq.a: Run a faucet, watch the flow icon on display.

title: Low Salt
fullDescription: Err 5 warns that salt is low; regeneration efficiency drops until refilled.

title: Memory Error
fullDescription: Err 6 indicates that saved settings have been lost; the unit uses defaults until reprogrammed.

title: Overfill / Brine Valve
shortDescription: Brine tank overfilled or brine valve stuck.
fullDescription: Err 7 can indicate brine tank is overfilling because the brine valve float is stuck open, risking water on the floor.
whenToCallPro: If water leaked onto floor and drywall.

title: Generic Controller Error
fullDescription: On older GE models without numeric codes, 'Er' flashes for a variety of controller faults; cycle power and re-check.
